comments.text:
🏔 Would you leave a house with power and TV to live 4 months in a yurt? In this Kyrgyzstan documentary, families still do it, for a reason you won't guess. 👇 Yurt on the summer pasture, or stay in the village? Tell us below, and subscribe for the next journey.
#Kyrgyzstan #KyrgyzstanTravel #CentralAsia

replies.author: @JuanitaRichards-c4t
replies.text: Id go to the yurt to get away from people...for some of the time. 😆

comments.author: @TheDistantLens_Us
comments.text: Do they really release the eagle after 15 to 20 years? How do the young hunters learn to train a new bird?

comments.author: @AmazingDiscoveriesTopUS
comments.text: The golden eagles and nomadic life in the moutains are absolutely fascinating. What an incredible culture!

replies.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
replies.text: We even filmed the moment his golden eagle, trained for almost two decades, spread its wings and flew free over the Tian Shan peaks.
